# Language regression catalog

This project exercises shape/dtype programs, descriptors, literals, inheritance,
multiple dialects, and concrete graphs. It is consumed by native tests and both
code generation integration scripts. Its generated output is named `sample`.

See [fixture ownership](../README.md). For learning examples, use
[Basic](../../../examples/basic/README.md) or
[reusable rules](../../../examples/advanced/reusable_rules/README.md).
